name: powershell-workbench
description: Portable PowerShell and mixed-language scaffolding, refactoring, discovery, agent harnesses, game tooling, and opt-in quality workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build and improve dual-compatible PowerShell safely.
interface.longDescription: Generate reusable PowerShell artifacts, discover and refactor single or multi-project workspaces, diagnose toolchains and patch transport, build safe PowerShell agent harnesses, package the plugin for another machine, and run quality or security gates only when requested.
defaultPrompt: Safely diagnose and edit this rejected or compact PowerShell patch with minimal churn.
